claims.text: The resort is in the Lhaviyani Atoll.

findings.note: Official page gives the resort's location as Lhaviyani Atoll.

claims.text: The atoll is surrounded by turquoise waters, vibrant reefs and white beaches.

findings.quote: Our beautiful Lhaviyani atoll home is surrounded by turquoise waters, vibrant reefs, and endless white beaches.

claims.text: Villas range from one to three bedrooms, suiting couples, families and larger groups.

findings.quote: Villas range from one-bedroom to three-bedroom, offering a vast array of accommodation options suitable for couples, families and larger groups alike.

claims.text: Multi-bedroom villas are available both on the beach and over the water.

findings.quote: A vast array of multi-bedroom villas on the beach and over water call for the perfect tropical family escape.
findings.note: Multi-bedroom villas exist both on the beach and over the water.

findings.quote: There are a number of two-bedroom and three-bedroom beach villas and overwater villas

claims.text: Diving is offered at sites around Lhaviyani.

findings.quote: Diving in some of the most diverse, vibrant, and colorful sites in the Maldives.
findings.note: This line appears under the section heading 'Diving in Lhaviyani'.

claims.text: Watersports include paddling and sailing, with activities in, on or under the sea.

findings.quote: Splash, paddle, sail, or fall in the turquoise waters, choosing from an array of activities in, on, or under the sea.

claims.text: At the Earth Lab, guests turn everyday waste into something useful through workshops.

findings.quote: Our Earth Lab is where guests and hosts turn everyday waste — glass, paper, food scraps — into something useful, through workshops and tips to use back home.

claims.text: Sustainability Tours showcase the water bottling plant, Organic Garden and Orchid Garden.

findings.quote: We offer Sustainability Tours, where we showcase our operations, such as our water bottling plant, Organic Garden, Orchid Garden, and energy conservation efforts.
findings.note: All three named items are listed.

claims.text: A castaway lunch island is a boat ride away, and a third island is left entirely to nature.

findings.quote: a castaway lunch island just a boat ride away, and a third left entirely to nature and your imagination.

claims.text: The resort encompasses three private islands.

findings.quote: Encompassing three private islands, Six Senses Kanuhura resort is a 40-minute seaplane ride from Malé International Airport
Our second Maldives property encompasses three white-sanded private islands, two of them deserted

claims.text: Guests can have a castaway experience on two deserted islands just off Kanuhura.

findings.quote: Castaway experience on two deserted islands just off the shores of Kanuhura.

claims.text: Accommodation is beach, family and overwater pool villas, with the lagoon at your feet.

findings.quote: With 85 spacious beach, family, and overwater pool villas, the lagoon is at your feet

claims.text: A Marine Biology team monitors and protects turtles, coral and seagrass across the atoll year-round, sharing progress through talks and in-water experiences.

findings.quote: starting with our Marine Biology team, who monitor and protect turtles, coral, and seagrass across the atoll year-round, sharing their progress via talks and in-water experiences.
findings.note: Matches every element of the claim.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive island experience.
